prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Antigua and Barbuda
Primary request: Antigua Naval Dockyard, Nelson's Dockyard in English Harbour, a sheltered historic dockyard in a turquoise Caribbean bay.
Subject: Recognizable low Georgian dockyard buildings of weathered warm stone and brick, pale trim, simple hipped roofs and shaded verandas along the quay, with a few modest modern sailing boats.
Scene/backdrop: A deep narrow natural harbour sheltered by green tropical hills, a few palms and blue sky. Dockyard buildings at water level, not perched high in the hills.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable architecture and boats, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Calm broad view across the harbour toward the dockyard; main historic buildings and boats in the central 75% of width and height with breathing room for cropping.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, bright and inviting.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No pirate ships, warships, giant cruise ship, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected original PNG. Low warm-stone Georgian dockyard buildings with hipped roofs/verandas along sea-level quay, sheltered turquoise harbour and green hills. Modest modern sailing yachts; no pirate ships/warships/cruise ship. Main buildings well framed; one tall mast extends into upper crop margin. Brush-textured style matches reference. No readable text/UI/flags/logos/unrelated landmark.
